label: Chance at a source: incidental coincidence, varying set-up, indeterministic propensity
resolution: CHANCE_1 (incidental: a varying concurring condition) and CHANCE_2 (a varying set-up) are both excluded at a source with an invariant set-up (Model.Laws 1 of the will-versus-chance batch); only CHANCE_3 (a non-rational power that gives otherwise from the same set-up) is the chance rival at a simple, patientless source. The arguments of the batch use CHANCE_3 only, and only inside the controls; no argument passes from one sense to another. The senses are not exclusive in general (a giver may have CHANCE_2 at one accessible world and CHANCE_3 at another) and no coverage of all chance is claimed. Willed two-way giving (choice) is not a sense of chance: it differs from CHANCE_3 only in the Rational classification (flip law).
